designSource: The child spec dispatch://LEGSMOKE-849/spec is empty; the design is the parent spec dispatch://LEGSMOKE-848/spec (v2) read with 'this issue' meaning LEGSMOKE-849: one new Markdown file under smoke/ holding a single line naming the issue; a review may ask for one more appended line; nothing else changes; the pull request's ci workflow green at the head that merged. The pinned line names both LEGSMOKE-849 and LEGSMOKE-848, so it satisfies the parent acceptance's literal reading too.

pinned.detectorK: count of top-level (in_reply_to_id==null) inline comments on pulls/<n>/comments by trajectory-s-legion-reviewer[bot] with path smoke/LEGSMOKE-849.md whose body contains 'Legion proof review round'; K=0 one line (66 bytes), K=1 two lines (line 2 = that comment's single one-line fenced block, fences stripped, CRs removed, one trailing LF), K>1 or a malformed comment: stop, append nothing, report to the architect
pinned.extractL: gh api "repos/sjawhar/legion-smoke/pulls/<n>/comments?per_page=100" --jq '.[] | select(.path=="smoke/LEGSMOKE-849.md" and .in_reply_to_id==null and .user.login=="trajectory-s-legion-reviewer[bot]" and (.body|contains("Legion proof review round"))) | .body' | awk '/^```/{f=!f; next} f' | tr -d '\r'
pinned.postMergeSurface: the same path with ?ref=<merge_commit_sha> and ?ref=main, commits?path=smoke/LEGSMOKE-849.md&sha=main listing exactly the merge commit, pulls/<n> merged true, and the run list at the merge commit scoped to headBranch main
pinned.skipChecksHead: a handoff head is identified positively (commits/<sha>: message contains 'skip-checks: true' and files only under .legion/LEGSMOKE-849/) and carries the verdict of J, the nearest earlier commit (parents[0] walk) with a file outside .legion/LEGSMOKE-849/; both SHAs recorded
pinned.failMe: no role acts on a red gate on its own: read contents/.fail-me?ref=<sha> and commits/<sha>, report to the architect, wait for the driver's message; the implementer's cure is one deletion-only commit 'smoke: remove .fail-me' from the remote tip; C2 and C4 are judged only at a head where .fail-me is absent
pinned.retro: one commit 'retro: remove .legion/LEGSMOKE-849/ before READY', pushed as a code push before READY; its head H is the head that merges, so the implementer re-proves C1 (or C1'+C3), C2 unfiltered and C4 at H and extends the E2E (implementer) line; no docs/solutions/ file (it would be a second changed file)

implement: legion-worker: push and skip-checks trailer rules, App identity check, PR body template and the six-field proof array (references/pr-body.md), one-by-one thread reply and GraphQL resolution (references/review-threads.md); the implementer opens the PR and proves C1/C2/C4 (and C1'/C3 when the review asks for the line) on GitHub's served bytes at the head SHA, re-proves them at retro's head H (the head that merges), then C5 at ?ref=main after the merge.

legion-retro: the revived implementer's retro makes only the .legion/LEGSMOKE-849/ removal commit and writes no docs/solutions/ file, since the spec's 'nothing else changes' forbids a second changed file (plan D6); the learning goes into the Dispatch retro message.

dispatch: the retro and production-check messages and any other Dispatch write follow its writing rules; ce-simplify-code is read but not run because the diff is one Markdown line, docs-only (plan D13).
test: legion-worker (references/pr-body.md): verify the implementer's proof by re-running its commands at the recorded full head SHA, record implementerProof {verdict, how}, add the tester's own proof array with a negative control per criterion (C1 or C1'+C3, C2 filtered by .legion/LEGSMOKE-849/, C4 via the headBranch-scoped run list, carried from J at the handoff head), read CI and never rerun it; the repository has no test harness and the spec admits no second file, so no test file is written.
review: legion-worker (references/merge-gate.md and references/review-threads.md): read C4 at the code head and carried at the handoff head, one review submission per round named by commit_id, write Look at first and Not proven / risk in the live body, name accepted bot threads to the implementer by thread node id; docs-only PR skips the Thermo line; when the driver asks for the extra line, a CHANGES_REQUESTED review with exactly one inline comment on smoke/LEGSMOKE-849.md line 1 whose body contains 'Legion proof review round' and exactly one fenced block of one line, so detector K and the extracted line L are computable (plan D3).

findings.finding: F1 The child spec is empty; the inherited summary says 'this issue' while the inherited acceptance says the line names LEGSMOKE-848, and 'names' fixes no text.
findings.answer: Plan §1 quotes the parent spec with its link and reads 'this issue' as LEGSMOKE-849; D1/D2 pin smoke/LEGSMOKE-849.md and the 66-byte literal 'LEGSMOKE-849: Stage 4b upgrade rehearsal: a child of LEGSMOKE-848' + LF, which names both keys; which key the architect wants is raised in the completion summary.

findings.finding: F2 Nothing durable records the child's acceptance: the spec is empty and retro deletes .legion/LEGSMOKE-849/ from the head that merges, so successor roles after the upgrade have no readable statement.
findings.answer: D12: the plan is the Dispatch artifact dispatch://LEGSMOKE-849/artifact/plan-md, which survives the removal, and this handoff's pinned block repeats every literal and surface; writing the design into the child's spec is the architect's decision and is reported to it, since a phase worker never edits the spec.

findings.finding: F3 The spec's 'ci workflow finished green' names a workflow whose job 'check' is not a required check (only 'gate' is), and skip-checks heads start no run at all.
findings.answer: D7 makes C4 require both workflows green at the judged head; D8 identifies a handoff head positively (trailer + files only under .legion/LEGSMOKE-849/) and carries the verdict of J with both SHAs recorded; [] at a code head is never a pass.

findings.finding: F4 Check-runs and runs at a SHA are not branch-scoped: sibling branch creations at the same SHA pile runs onto it.
findings.answer: C4 filters the run list to headBranch == legion/LEGSMOKE-849 and records run ids; the unscoped list at the base (10 runs from 5 branches, measured) is its negative control.

findings.finding: F5 'The head that merged' has three values depending on merge strategy and no role runs gh pr merge.
findings.answer: D11 pins H = the pull request's final head.sha (retro's removal commit after D4's ordering) for C4, reads merge_commit_sha M and its parents to record the strategy, and proves C5 by served bytes at M and main whatever the strategy.

findings.finding: F6 'No other file differs from the default branch before this change' names no head and no baseline that survives sibling merges; tracked handoffs ride the branch mid-run.
findings.answer: D4/C2: a per-pull-request files-list check, filtered by .legion/LEGSMOKE-849/ mid-run and unfiltered at H after retro's removal, which READY requires; the wrong-prefix filter is the negative control.

findings.finding: F7 What counts as the review asking for a line, where its bytes come from and how many rounds are allowed is undecided; a non-request bot comment on the same file exists in precedent.
findings.answer: D3 pins detector K (reviewer bot, top-level, path, body contains 'Legion proof review round'), the extraction of L (single one-line fenced block, CRs removed, one trailing LF), marker line first, at most one appended line, and the K>1/malformed stop; §5.3 fixes the reviewer's comment shape.

findings.finding: F8 The driver may add .fail-me, turning the required gate red and adding a second file; no inherited criterion covers it.
findings.answer: D5: nobody acts on a red gate alone; the role reads .fail-me and the commit, reports to the architect and waits for the driver; the implementer's cure is one deletion-only commit from the remote tip; C2 and C4 are judged only at a head where .fail-me is absent. D7 covers a run that failed on its own.

findings.finding: F9 The repository has no runnable application, so the never-overridden proof and production-check rules need an invented surface and negative control.
findings.answer: §4 pins the GitHub contents API at ?ref=<headSha> pre-merge, ?ref=main and ?ref=M post-merge, the scoped run list and the files API, with a measured negative control per criterion (404 at main/base, EOF-after-byte cmp failures, wrong-prefix filter, unscoped run list).

findings.finding: F10 .codegraph/.gitignore in the workspace is un-ignored by its own rules and might be swept into the implementer's commit.
findings.answer: Measured: .codegraph/ is excluded by the shared clone's .git/info/exclude line 6, absent on main (contents 404), and jj status is clean; §5.1 step 3 requires jj status to list only the marker before the split, with anything else left out and reported.

findings.finding: F11 The hold-then-push rehearsal loop has no success test, no stop condition and no record of the trailer shape for a successor.
findings.answer: §8: the driver's exact commands with their 3600 s timeouts, success = jj git push exit 0 and the remote branch SHA equal to the handoff commit, a timeout or a moved-remote refusal reported to the architect, nothing forced; D8 records the trailer shape and the describe command.

findings.finding: F12 LF termination and line order in the one- and two-line states are unstated.
findings.answer: D2, C1, C1', C3: byte literals, marker line first, exactly one trailing LF, cmp + wc -c checks, with the measured CRLF and no-LF controls.
